subject: CAIQ exception log + evidence handback for Clearwater Health
messages:
From: Evelyn Marsh <audit@security-assessors.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: paul.ramirez@clearwaterhealth.com, legal@clearwaterhealth.com
Date: 2027-10-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ intake: exception log & targeted evidence for Clearwater Health

Hi Karthik / Kimberly,

Thanks again for taking this on. Clearwater indicated they want a scoped CAIQ submission focusing on Data Protection, Key Management, and Tenant Isolation controls. To keep the turnaround tight, we need: 

- A short exception log describing any controls that are partially implemented or have compensating controls (one-pager per exception).
- Sample runtime telemetry (anonymized) that demonstrates tenant isolation and prefix caching behavior for inference requests. A 7-day sample is ideal; redact PII.
- A short attestation for KMS rotation and HSM usage (who/what/where; date of last rotation).
- The latest CAIQ CSV with your answers and any follow-up notes for controls you flag as "partial" or "not applicable".

Please send the package and a proposed 60-minute working session next week so we can walk through the exceptions and map them to the auditor checklist. If you prefer, send an initial package and we’ll schedule the session after a quick review.

Attachments: CAIQ_template_v2.xlsx (attached)

Best,
Evelyn Marsh
Security Assessors, Inc.

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Evelyn Marsh <audit@security-assessors.com>, paul.ramirez@clearwaterhealth.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-10-09T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake: exception log & targeted evidence for Clearwater Health

Evelyn — thanks for the clear ask. We can assemble a scoped bundle but want to avoid over-sharing runtime samples. Proposal:

- Deliver a CAIQ CSV with our annotated answers and explicit tracebacks to internal artifact IDs.
- Provide an exception register (PDF) that lists the control, short description, rationale, compensating controls, owner, and ETA for remediation.
- For runtime telemetry, we can provide a synthetic replay that mirrors tenant isolation behavior plus sanitized request/response headers rather than raw customer tokens.
- KMS attestation: we’ll produce a short signed statement from our infra sec lead and include the last rotation snapshot.

Proposed timeline:
- Draft CAIQ + exception register -> Wed 2027-10-13 EOD PT
- Synthetic telemetry bundle + KMS attestation -> Fri 2027-10-15 EOD PT
- Working session (60m) -> Tue 2027-10-19 10:00–11:00 PT (please confirm)

I’ve attached an initial evidence manifest (evidence_manifest_v1.csv) that maps each requested artifact to an internal owner. Kimberly, Marissa — I’ve flagged the controls where we anticipate partial implementation (DP-3, KM-2, TI-1). Can you confirm owners and whether we need input from platform-ops for the synthetic replay?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Evelyn Marsh <audit@security-assessors.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, paul.ramirez@clearwaterhealth.com
Date: 2027-10-09T13:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake: exception log & targeted evidence for Clearwater Health

On 2027-10-09 09:12, Evelyn Marsh wrote:
> Thanks again for taking this on. Clearwater indicated they want a scoped CAIQ submission focusing on Data Protection, Key Management, and Tenant Isolation controls.

Per Karthik’s note — owners confirmed. Quick operational plan:

- DP-3 (Data encryption in transit/rest): Owner = Marissa Cole (Platform Security). Deliverable = TLS config snapshot + encryption key usage table. ETA 10/15.
- KM-2 (KMS rotation & splitting keys): Owner = Priya Natarajan (Key Mgmt). Deliverable = KMS attestation PDF + rotation history CSV. ETA 10/15.
- TI-1 (Tenant isolation): Owner = Platform-ops (Connor O'Brien). Deliverable = synthetic replay package + architecture note + firewall rules extract. ETA 10/14.

Action items (short):
1) Marissa — prepare TLS and encryption table (10/15).
2) Priya — export rotation snapshot + signer statement (10/15).
3) Platform-ops — produce sanitized replay (10/14) and confirm sample size.
4) Karthik — compile CAIQ CSV and populate exception register (draft 10/13).
5) Kimberly — prepare one-page control rationale for DP-3 and KM-2 to attach to the package.

Attachments: redline_example.docx (template for exception log), deployment_runbook_snippet.txt

Kimberly Park
Director, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Marsh <audit@security-assessors.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: paul.ramirez@clearwaterhealth.com, legal@clearwaterhealth.com
Date: 2027-10-09T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake: exception log & targeted evidence for Clearwater Health

Kimberly / Karthik — perfect, that timeline works for us. A couple quick clarifications before the working session: 

- For the synthetic replay, include the mapping that shows how tenant IDs are scoped to compute instances (a diagram + short narrative is enough).
- For KMS attestation, we’ll need the key policy view (redacted) and the date/owner of the last emergency rotation if one occurred in the past 12 months.
- Please flag any controls where a compensating control is a manual process (we may request additional sampling).

We’ll tentatively accept Tue 10/19 10:00 PT for the working session; Paul (Clearwater) will confirm. If you can drop the draft CAIQ and exception register two business days prior (by 10/17), that gives us time to prepare follow-ups and draft requested redlines.

Thanks — looking forward to the session.

Evelyn Marsh
Security Assessors, Inc.
